name: Winged Rabbit(?)
source:
"Like! Like! Like you!"

Living in the Northern Valley Forest, they are extremely cautious and cowardly. Normally they are light and small, except the fat one. You meet this fatty as your friend in Gedonelune.

[Official in-game description]
